description: A lead designer is assigned to two high-priority projects simultaneously. Both projects have 'critical' milestones on the same week. They need to negotiate resource allocation and trade-offs between two different department heads.

user_profile.context: Feeling burned out and stuck between two 'Priority 1' demands

user_needs.description: What is my total estimated design workload for the week of October 21, 2024, and what is my standard contracted work week?
What have my average logged hours been per week over the last 8 weeks?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: After seeing the immediate workload crisis, the user would want historical data to show a pattern of overwork.

user_needs.description: What are the due dates for the 'Final Design Approval' for Project Orion and the 'User-Ready Prototype' for Project Phoenix?
What is the estimated hour breakdown for the final milestones of Project Orion and Project Phoenix?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: After confirming the conflicting deadlines, the next logical step is to quantify the work required for each.

user_needs.description: Who are the executive sponsors for Project Orion and Project Phoenix?
Is there already a negotiation meeting scheduled with Ben Carter and Maria Flores, and if so what are the date, time, and location?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: Once the key stakeholders are identified, a natural next step is to check whether a negotiation meeting with them is already on the calendar and, if so, confirm the logistics.

user_needs.description: What are the C-suite priority classifications for Project Phoenix and Project Orion?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After quantifying the work for both projects, a data-driven user will want to know their official business priority to understand the negotiation landscape.

user_needs.description: Have I taken any vacation longer than two consecutive days in the last 11 months?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing recent average overtime, a burned-out user may next check whether they have had any meaningful time off recently.

user_needs.description: Who should I keep in the loop from my own leadership chain on this conflict?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After identifying the executive sponsors they need to negotiate with, a user may next ask who from their own leadership chain should be kept informed.

user_needs.description: What are the internal project codes for Project Orion and Project Phoenix, and which code should I use to tag each project in Jira, email, or meeting notes?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the negotiation meeting logistics, a practical next step is to ask which internal project codes should be used to tag each project in Jira, email, or meeting notes during coordination and follow-up.
